name: RTX-Accelerated Empty Space Skipping using Triangulated Active Bricks
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses RTX-accelerated ray tracing to skip empty space by tracing rays against a BVH constructed over the boundary between active and inactive regions, rather than over all active regions.
summary: RTX-Accelerated Empty Space Skipping uses hardware-accelerated BVH traversal on boundary triangle meshes to efficiently skip empty volume regions, reducing depth complexity compared to prior methods.
